text:
I rewrote the opening of the system-map `requirements.md`, because the title and the ask paragraph were too hard to scan. The text check came back clean.

- **Title:** "A map of dictation's background work, and an index of what's been built (you are a mastermind, on Sonnet; audits go to Haiku)" is now "Dictation: map the background work". The role note moved to its own line under it.
- **Ask paragraph:** it ran about 75 words, over the 60-word limit. It is now a quote plus two bullets, **Find out** and **Method**.
- **Not checked:** I didn't screenshot it, since it's an agent brief with no page.

My first log line went wrong. My temp path failed, so the append picked up an old `/tmp/l.json` and wrote a stale "chat-model clear" line to `flags.jsonl`. I then appended the correct "rewrote" line for this target. The stale line is still there and I left it, since logs aren't deleted.

I rewrote the system-map outcome as a checklist of the four asks with proof links, and logged a "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`. The old outcome had no ask list, so none of the asks were ticked against proof.

- **Ticked:**
  - The background-job inventory is in `background-work.md`. It has 13 jobs and I confirmed the file exists.
  - The Dictate readme and `map.md` each link the map, and I confirmed both links.
  - `built-index.md` exists and the handover links it.
- **Left unticked:** the 5-line report to vscode-mastermind, because nothing shows it was sent.
- **Checks:** `text-check` printed no flags. I did not shoot the pages, because the task changed only docs and its `layout-check` was skipped for that reason.

The edit is one appended `{"assign": {"outcome": …}}` line in the task's `session.jsonl`. I applied it myself instead of sending it to an owner, because the mastermind had already landed. I did not check whether the agent was still running.
